slides.idea: Where does a Project's group list live?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Where does a Project's group list live?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A "Each Block's _groups.txt": three folders, each with its own small list
 Card B "One list per Project", circled in orange with a small tag "leaning": one list at the top, lines down to three folders
 Card C "Tags only": three cards, each with small tag labels
Bottom-right sticky note: "Still open: does each Block keep its own file?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Leaning: the second (s07-D01: one shared list per Project). Still open: Does each Block keep its own file as a subset?

slides.idea: How does one topic point to another?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "How does one topic point to another?"
Two large topic cards side by side: left "b35-s03", right "b35-s02".
A solid hand-drawn arrow from left to right labelled "Links"; a dashed arrow from right back to left labelled "Linked from".
Above both cards, one ribbon spanning them labelled "group: Interface".
Bottom-right sticky note: "Still open: full label or address?"
Focal point: the two arrows.
slides.notes: Leaning: agreed (s07-D01). Still open: Full label or address only on the Links line?
